description: Source code for EmployeeEducationAPI class in a Human Resource Management system. Defines API endpoints for managing employee education records, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of education data for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing employee education records, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion. Implements CRUD operations and validation rules for employee education data.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationService
methods.description: Lazy loader for EmployeeEducationService instance used for handling business logic related to employee education.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific employee's education record by ID.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts URL parameters: employee number and education record ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single employee education record.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all education records for a specified employee, with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing employee education records.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new education record for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new employee education record.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for the request body when creating or updating employee education records.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee education record by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an employee education record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or multiple education records for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deletion requests.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeEducation entity with data from request parameters and persists it.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for employee number parameter.
